    base_url: &crate::translation_core::Str,
    token: crate::translation_core::Maybe<&crate::translation_core::Str>,
    provider: crate::translation_core::Maybe<UsageProvider>,
    json: bool,
) -> ExitCode {

    run_with_limit(
        &client,
        base_url,
        token,
        provider,
        json,
        crate::subscription_usage::MAX_USAGE_BODY,
    )
    .await
}
